epsilon.description: Allowed error for the float checker, else 0.

generator_python.description: Python 3 generator: argv[1] is the seed, then key=value arguments; prints one valid input; deterministic for a seed.

reference_cpp.description: Correct, efficient C++17 solution reading stdin and writing stdout.

input.description: Exact sample input, ending with a newline.

output.description: Exact expected output, ending with a newline.

slug.description: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, like best-stretch.

statement_md.description: Markdown statement with $...$ maths and the sections ## Input, ## Output and ## Constraints. No samples in the statement.

subtasks.description: One to four subtasks; points add up to 100.

constraints.description: The subtask's extra constraints in one line.

generator_args.description: Arguments after the seed, each like n=1000, matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_.,:=+-]{1,64}$.

tags.description: Up to five lowercase topic tags.

title.description: Short title in sentence case, under 60 characters.

validator_python.description: Python 3 validator: reads an input on stdin, exits 0 if it meets the constraints exactly, else prints why to stderr and exits 1.
